title: Chapter 160 Generous Elegy
content:
Chapter 160 Generous Elegy

Defeated, I was defeated just like that, my army of tens of thousands disappeared completely within a short moment, leaving only a few hundred people like myself, still living in the world.

Yan Dan felt a burst of sadness, fear welling up in his heart uncontrollably, and he had nowhere to express his helplessness!

"Are things in the world really such a trick to people?

"

Yan Dan stood alone on the battlefield in a state of embarrassment, surrounded by hundreds of surviving remnants of soldiers, wrapping him tightly, using their bodies to block all damage for him as much as possible.

Hearing the words of their coach at this moment, my heart was filled with mixed feelings, and tears flowed out of these tough men, which were rare.

"His Royal Highness, I can't blame you for all this. I can only blame it. The time does not wait for the Yan Kingdom, and the time does not wait for you. The Yan Kingdom has fallen behind the rest of the world. It has been too long. The stubborn nobles are like cancer rooted in Yan. Country Yan, which is imprisoned by a decaying system, should be full of vitality." Beside Yan Dan, a handsome general wearing a general's uniform cried and said.

"Yeah, time doesn't wait for me, time doesn't wait for me! God, I, Yan Dan, was sent to Zhao State as a hostage since I was a child, and was even sent to Qin State when I was an adult. I lived a life of fear and precarity."

"After finally returning to China, I thought I could show my talents and reform my country, which has been stagnant for a long time, so that it can regain its vitality and reverse its fate that is heading towards destruction!"

"Unexpectedly, traitors and sycophants are in the way, and the whole room is full of stupid people who only know how to enjoy themselves but not worry. Now, most of the territory of Yan Kingdom has been lost, and the people have been displaced. The day Dan dies!"

Yan Dan's tone was full of sadness.

"His Royal Highness, we will live and die with you, and we will fight until the last moment. Even if the country of Yan dies, it must die with dignity!" Many soldiers around Yan Dan heard that their master, Prince Dan, had this identity. The people who are honorable but have a lot of fate, made this exclamation, and they all expressed their opinions and made up their minds.

"You stubborn people are still engaged in meaningless battles for the so-called Yan Kingdom and the so-called glory. You are so stupid!" Walking closer, Zhang Liao listened to the ridiculous loyalty of these people. The sense of honor, sneered.

"That's right, allegiance is also to a person who is worthy of your allegiance. How can you easily entrust your loyalty to a person who is not worthy of your entrustment? Is this how you despise yourself?" Xu Huang said a little unbearably. Well, if these loyal and brave soldiers can serve their own country and cooperate with a wise and decisive king with a clear political court, what a powerful force it would be.

"Being in the country of Yan is God's decision, but choosing to be a soldier of the country of Yan is our decision!" A resolute general beside Yan Dan said this in a solemn tone.

"That's right, we are fighting not for the king of Yan, for those high-ranking nobles, but for our country of Yan, for the honor of the country of Yan, and for the people of the country of Yan who are robbed and bullied by you. This is why we fight to the death!" A general next to him shouted.

"Defending the land and defending the country is the duty of a soldier. As a soldier of the country of Yan, if he can't protect the people of the country of Yan and defend the dignity of the country of Yan, how can he live in the world with any face!" All the soldiers shouted together, which represents their common aspirations.

"Very well, I appreciate your persistence, but the goal you stick to makes me feel angry. This weak Yan country, how can He De have you mediocre people? This fatuous Yan king? It has been cultivated for several generations. Blessings, to have subjects like you, but don’t know how to cherish them!” Zhao Yun was admiring for a while when he heard the reply from the soldiers of the Yan Kingdom, but then he changed his words abruptly.

"However, since you have chosen to be enemies with me and the country, and also for the sake of the emperor of my country, the dignity of the soldiers of the empire, and the people of the country, our duty is to kill you to stabilize the overall situation of the country!"

"Please, accept death obediently, I will give you a decent way to die, like a soldier, die with dignity!" Zhao Yun said at the end, his tone was still full of murderous intentions, and he swung his silver spear towards these people. The soldiers of Yan State who were standing on foot rushed over

"Although I really don't want to, but I can't help it!" After saying this, Xu Huang also rushed over.

"Haha, Zhang Fei is choking me to death. You ignorant scumbags, who don't know Wang Hua, don't know the general idea, just let me, Zhang Fei, and you have a few transparent holes!" Zhang Fei laughed and rushed over.

The other generals, seeing the situation in front of them, did not hesitate at all, and chose their duties. As a soldier, orders are their highest code of obedience, and they cannot choose to violate them for any reason.

"Victory to the Empire, Long Live His Majesty the Emperor!" Tens of thousands of soldiers shouted this sentence in unison, holy and solemn, and it has been deeply imprinted in their hearts, brains, and bones

In a few moments, the last hundreds of soldiers of the Yan Kingdom disappeared under the siege of the generals of the Yu Kingdom, leaving only Prince Dan, a first-rate master, fighting alone.

Death, from the moment they chose to protrude from the city wall, stay away from the high defense protection, and face the hundreds of thousands of troops of the Yu Kingdom, was already inevitably doomed.

Amidst the ruins and ruined walls, this originally beautiful plain has become a realm of death after the ravages of tens of thousands of people.

Blood and corpses spread all over the ground, and discarded and broken weapons were inserted everywhere. With the end of each era, there are always countless people with lofty ideals emerging. Although most of them cannot restore the defeat, their spirit , but it has been extolled through the ages.

Even though this place is not in shape now, in the coming year, after so many corpses, the water and plants must be more lush and the land more fertile. If there are still people who dare to live here, the fields they planted must be There will be a good harvest!

The desolate figure of Ying should be alone, standing here quietly, surrounded by countless armies, but without the slightest fear, full of generosity and elegy.

"Since ancient times, there have been many generous and tragic men in Yanzhao, and there have been many heroes. You can't deceive me!" Xu Huang, who was born in the south, couldn't help sighing when he saw the scene in front of him.

"I, Yan Dan, is it time for my death? My miserable and not brilliant life is over!" Wei Ran sighed, Yan Dan pulled out the long sword and put it on the neck, as if The meaning of committing suicide.

"No, Dan, with me here, you can't die, and you won't!" In the distance, a red shadow leaped quickly.
